name: Vitaya para 2: Cavoe event
source:
It’s the summer of 2022. You play as Vanya, an 18-year-old aspiring esports player who just received a golden ticket to the legendary "Cavoe" retreat on the beautiful Ishigaki Island.
The host? None other than Peppy, the enigmatic creator of osu!.
You were told this was an exclusive VIP event for the top "geniuses" of the CIS gaming community. You expected free food, networking with top-tier streamers, and maybe some anime discussions.
You didn't expect to find your fellow guests decapitated with cryptic messages written in blood.
Trapped on an isolated island with a ship that won't arrive for three days, Peppy reveals the horrifying truth via the mansion's loudspeakers: this isn't a vacation. It's a real-life death game designed to promote osu!lazer and a new global PP-to-Ruble economy. The killer is one of the "geniuses" in the mansion.
To survive, you must investigate locked-room murders, debate alibis, and figure out which of your gambling-addicted, steroid-fueled, and anime-obsessed peers is hunting you down.
Click circles. Gamble skins. Try to keep your head attached to your neck.
translation:
这是2022年的夏天。你扮演Vanya，一位18岁的有抱负的电子竞技运动员，刚刚收到一张前往美丽石垣岛上传奇的“Cavoe”静修所的金票。
主人？正是Peppy，osu! 的神秘创造者。
有人告诉你这是独联体游戏界顶级“天才”的独家VIP活动。你期待免费的食物、与顶级主播的交流，也许还有一些动漫讨论。
你没想到会发现你的同伴被斩首，上面写满了用血写成的神秘信息。
佩皮被困在一座孤岛上，船上三天之内都不会抵达，他通过宅邸的扩音器透露了可怕的事实：这不是假期。这是一款现实生活中的死亡游戏，旨在推广osu!lazer和新的全球PP兑换卢布经济。凶手是豪宅中的“天才”之一。
为了生存，你必须调查密室谋杀案，辩论不在场证据，并找出哪个沉迷于赌博、吸食类固醇、痴迷动漫的同龄人正在追捕你。
单击圆圈。赌博皮肤。尽量让头紧贴脖子。
